governanceFields.infra_kpi_exec: Regional CALA hubs + HE enterprise platform
governanceFields.infra_asset_management_reporting:
Weekly flash KPIs for open CALA assets (where live)
Monthly owner operating and financial packs
Quarterly business reviews with asset-level action plans
CapEx and PIP tracking aligned to brand and owner priorities
Secure owner document sharing for management agreements and transitions
governanceFields.infra_systems_technology:
PMS: Brand-dependent by asset (Marriott / Hilton / Hyatt family systems)
RMS & commercial: HE enterprise revenue support + brand RMS where required
Distribution: Brand CRS and channel connectivity; regional sales activation
Accounting: Property-level finance with HE shared services (Mexico SSC) support
Owner reporting: Structured monthly packs and portfolio visibility for institutional owners
Openings & IT: CALA openings/IT leadership for cutover, cybersecurity, and readiness
governanceFields.systems_inventory_lines:
Owner reporting portal / secure document exchange (asset-level)
HE enterprise training and commercial support systems
Regional shared services (finance, HR, procurement coordination)
Brand compliance and technical services workflows per franchise agreement

infra_technology_stack_json.title: PMS / Property Operations
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Brand-mandated property systems for reservations, guest folios, and daily operations—supported through HE CALA openings and transition playbooks.
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, or soft-brand equivalents by asset

infra_technology_stack_json.title: RMS / Revenue Management
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Pricing, forecasting, and yielding coordinated with HE commercial platform and in-market revenue leadership (Martha Estrada, Margie Aristy Mai).
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Brand RMS + HE enterprise revenue support

infra_technology_stack_json.title: CRS / Distribution
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Central reservations, brand distribution, and channel strategy for resort and urban/lifestyle assets across CALA markets.

infra_technology_stack_json.title: Accounting / Owner Reporting
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Monthly financial discipline, owner statements, and shared-services support anchored in Mexico SSC with CALA finance leadership.
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Property accounting + HE shared services (Mariana Gonzalez, Martin Larralde)

infra_technology_stack_json.title: Openings, IT & Cyber
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Systems cutover, milestone tracking, and technology readiness for takeovers, conversions, and new openings in island and gateway markets.
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Maria del Pilar Garcia · CALA Openings & IT

infra_technology_stack_json.title: Labor & HR Systems
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Hiring, scheduling, and associate engagement systems aligned to resort/all-inclusive labor intensity and local market rules.
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Rodrigo Cuello · Salomé Baena · regional HR

infra_technology_stack_json.title: BI / Portfolio Visibility
infra_technology_stack_json.description: Operating KPIs, pacing, and owner-facing views—strongest on open assets; expanding as CALA portfolio scales from 5 open / 12 pipeline (public HE posts, 2026).
infra_technology_stack_json.examples: Owner dashboards and monthly business review packs

infra_services_offered_json.title: Pre-Opening & Transition Systems
infra_services_offered_json.description: Opening readiness, PMS/RMS cutover planning, milestone governance, and stabilization support for CALA takeovers and new builds.

infra_services_offered_json.title: Owner Reporting & Data Room
infra_services_offered_json.description: Monthly packs, variance commentary, secure document exchange, and institutional-style visibility for Caribbean & Latin America owners.

infra_services_offered_json.title: Revenue & Distribution Support
infra_services_offered_json.description: Commercial activation, channel strategy, and pricing architecture tied to resort, all-inclusive, and urban/lifestyle positioning.

infra_services_offered_json.title: Shared Services (Finance & Back Office)
infra_services_offered_json.description: Mexico-based shared services supporting forecasting, AP/AR rhythm, and reporting consistency across the CALA portfolio.

infra_services_offered_json.title: Brand Compliance & Technical Services
infra_services_offered_json.description: Franchise and soft-brand operating standards, QA coordination, and technical services workflows per brand agreement.

infra_services_offered_json.title: Procurement & F&B Systems Coordination
infra_services_offered_json.description: Leverages HE enterprise procurement and F&B operating support—especially relevant for resort and all-inclusive assets.

infra_data_domains_json.title: Commercial & Leisure Demand
items: ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, pace, and pickup
All-inclusive and package economics where applicable

infra_data_domains_json.title: Financial & Owner Reporting
items: CapEx and PIP status by asset

infra_data_domains_json.title: Labor & Resort Operations
items: F&B intensity and seasonal labor patterns
Service recovery and guest satisfaction themes

infra_data_domains_json.title: Geography & Portfolio
items: Market-level performance (DR, Mexico, TCI, Curaçao, etc.)
Owner priority themes by asset type

infra_data_domains_json.title: Risk & Continuity
items: Insurance and BCP cadence (HE enterprise frameworks, CALA adaptation)

infra_data_governance_json.title: Owner vs Operator Access
infra_data_governance_json.description: Role-based visibility for owners, asset managers, and CALA regional leaders—sensitive materials permissioned by asset and agreement.

infra_data_governance_json.title: Brand & Franchise Data Handling
infra_data_governance_json.description: Separates operator analytics from brand-mandated reporting packs; respects franchise system-of-record requirements.

infra_data_governance_json.title: Transition & Data Room Discipline
infra_data_governance_json.description: Organized repositories for LOIs, management agreements, opening budgets, and handover artifacts during CALA onboarding.

infra_data_governance_json.title: Reporting Version Control
infra_data_governance_json.description: Monthly pack versions, forecast updates, and meeting action logs tracked for institutional owner relationships.

infra_data_governance_json.title: Regional Privacy & Labor Rules
infra_data_governance_json.description: Data practices adapt to Mexico, Caribbean, and Central America regulatory context—not a single U.S.-only policy overlay.

infra_data_governance_json.title: Enterprise HE Alignment
infra_data_governance_json.description: CALA field data rolls into Hotel Equities enterprise standards for finance, HR, and risk where parent policies apply.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: Owner Monthly Business Review
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Connects KPIs, variance drivers, and action plans to owner priorities—primary institutional touchpoint for open assets.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: Resort & All-Inclusive Performance
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Benchmarks leisure assets on seasonality, package mix, F&B contribution, and labor productivity vs budget.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: Pipeline & Opening Analytics
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Tracks pre-opening spend, milestone risk, and ramp curves for signed CALA projects across island and gateway markets.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: Market & Competitive Context
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Frames CALA footprint (17 hotels: 5 open, 12 pipeline per public HE materials) against local supply and demand drivers.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: CapEx & Asset Protection
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Links PIP items, deferred maintenance, and owner-approved capital to operating and guest-experience outcomes.

infra_analytics_support_json.title: Portfolio Roll-Up (Emerging)
infra_analytics_support_json.description: Multi-asset comparison for owners with several CALA assets—maturing as the division scales beyond initial open base.
